newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein lower, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein lower, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were lower in early trading on Monday, with demand remaining thin ahead of the May 29 general election, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,415 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,420 rupiah at Friday's close, but trades were also heard at 1,410 rupiah.
"Buyers are not showing much interest, buying only small volumes as they try to keep stock levels low in case of any further unrest ahead of the elections," one trader said.
The traders said a riot in the South Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin last Friday had no major impact on the market.
The death toll from a fire and riot at a shopping centre in the city was reported to have risen to 142.

"Because it (Banjarmasin) is far from Jakarta, the incident did not have any significant impact on the market this morning," one trader said. "But players are generally cautious, and have only been buying just what they needed for immediate use."
Traders said they expected market activity to return to normal after the election, but added that prices could weaken further through the week in line with values overseas.
